layer1.name: Tally
layer1.one_liner: A form builder that works like a text document.
layer1.description: Forms are typed like a document rather than assembled from blocks, with almost everything free and a paid tier for advanced features. Two founders, entering a category with several large established players.
layer1.outcome_note: Bootstrapped from $30k ARR after year one to a reported $4M+ ARR with a deliberately small team and no outside investment.

sources.note: Founder's AMA at $30k ARR after one year
